User asks: create formula in Excel where cell J displays 'Yes' if cell H either contains a date or the word 'Yes', displays 'N/A' if cell H contains 'N/A', and displays 'No' if cell H is blank. Current formula IF(H2>1/1/1,"Yes","No"). Answer ranges Sheet1 J2:J4. Need likely replace formulas in J2:J4 with formula that checks H. Need preserve other cells.

Need decide formula. H2 is date serial, H3 "Yes", H4 "N/A". Need J2 Yes, J3 Yes, J4 N/A. If blank No. Need formula robust: =IF(H2="N/A","N/A",IF(OR(H2="Yes",ISNUMBER(H2)),"Yes","No"))? But if H contains date, ISNUMBER true. If H contains word Yes, true. If blank, false -> No. If H contains N/A, N/A. Need maybe date can be text? "contains a date" likely actual date. Could use ISNUMBER(H2) or ISTEXT? Current formula H>1/1/1 works for dates because date serial > 1. But for text "Yes" it's false? In Excel, text > number? Actually comparison text vs number: text is greater than any number? In Excel, text is greater than numbers. So "Yes" > 1/1/1 returns TRUE? Let's check: In Excel, comparison operators: numbers < text < logical? I think text is greater than numbers. So current formula returns Yes for "Yes" too. But for "N/A" also text > number -> Yes, which is wrong. Need explicit.

Need formula maybe =IF(H2="N/A","N/A",IF(OR(H2="Yes",ISNUMBER(H2)),"Yes","No")). For blank: H2=""? If blank, H2="N/A" false, OR(H2="Yes",ISNUMBER(H2)) false -> No. Good.

Could use =IF(H2="N/A","N/A",IF(OR(H2="Yes",H2>1/1/1),"Yes","No"))? But H2>1/1/1 for text "N/A" true, but N/A handled first. For other text maybe true, but spec only date or Yes. Better ISNUMBER.

Need consider if H contains date as text? "contains a date" maybe actual date. If date text, ISNUMBER false. Could use ISNUMBER(H2) or ISTEXT? But likely actual date. Could use =IF(H2="N/A","N/A",IF(OR(H2="Yes",ISNUMBER(H2)),"Yes","No")).

Need output operations. Could use fill_formula range J2:J4 with formula top-left =IF(H2="N/A","N/A",IF(OR(H2="Yes",ISNUMBER(H2)),"Yes","No")). Fill formula translates relative H2 to H3/H4. Good.

Need ensure JSON valid. route operations, summary. operations one fill_formula.

Need maybe preserve style? fill_formula only sets formula, style remains? likely. Could use set_formula individually. Fill formula okay.

Need no markdown. final JSON.
</think>
